title: Holding Several Gift Cards & Store Credit Instruments at Once
content:
A customer may hold any number of Gift Cards & Store Credit instruments of every type at once; there is no cap on the instruments one customer holds.

Instruments are never pooled automatically. Each instrument keeps its own balance, its own expiry and its own restrictions, and value moves from one instrument to another only by a replacement, or by a consolidation that the holder confirms.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of instruments one customer may hold? | No, for every type |
| Do two Return Store Credits held by the same customer share one balance? | No; each keeps its own balance, expiry and restrictions |
| Can value pass between two instruments without a replacement or a consolidation the holder confirms? | No |

Hypothetical illustration: a customer holding a Marlowe Rewards Note, two Return Store Credits and a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card holds four separate balances. The note keeps its own expiry date and the e-Gift Card keeps its own restrictions, even though all four sit in the same profile.
